plate.title: SMOKE
plate.subtitle: culture + sink
plate.design_notes: Circular ash-ring certificate hung on the archive wall behind Ember's desk, centred at eye level. Green desk lamp casts a soft cone from upper-left; neon rim adds a slow 3s glow pulse. Stamp hierarchy: 1) SMOKE title arc, 2) central Lounge-basket sink mark, 3) 'culture + sink' subtitle arc, 4) inward burn arrows as supporting motion. Plate bobs 2px on a 4s loop. No cigarette, no DEX UI, no QR, no numbers.

shapes: Outer ring: circle at 256,256 r240, rim stroke 10px, glow blur 18
Ash band: annulus r200-236, accent at 35% alpha, light speckle noise
Certificate edge: 48 small scallop arcs along r236, accent stroke 2px
Inner hairline ring: circle r196, rim stroke 1px at 50% alpha
Sink hole: circle r58 at centre, radial gradient #000000 to background
Basket mark in hole: bowl arc r40 lower half, rim stroke 4px
Basket weave: 4 vertical + 2 horizontal short lines in bowl, rim 2px
Basket rim: horizontal line across bowl top, rim stroke 4px
Burn arrows: 8 arrows at r185 pointing to centre, 45 deg apart, rim
Arrow tails: gradient from accent to transparent, extending outward
Title SMOKE: bold caps arced along top at r150, rim color with glow
Subtitle 'culture + sink': small caps arced along bottom r150, accent
Wisps: 3 faint bezier curves rising from hole, accent at 18% alpha
Vignette: radial darken outside r245 to canvas edge

plate.title: DIAMONDS
plate.subtitle: The Pressure Study
plate.design_notes: Use founder art 1 unaltered as the plate texture. Keep its energy: scroll floating upper-centre with slight tilt, dark cave walls framing it, chasm below, crystal clusters in the foreground. Frame: thin faceted silver-blue bevel, cut-corner octagon so the cave edges read as part of the frame. Lighting: cool top-down key from the cave opening, soft blue sparkle particles drifting near the scroll glyphs, slow mist loop along the bottom edge, occasional white glint travelling across one crystal. Stamp hierarchy: 1) the art's DIAMONDS title (never overlay text on the scroll), 2) small engraved plaque below the frame reading 'The Pressure Study', 3) three tiny facet seals bottom-right for CUT / WEIGH / STAMP that light in sequence when the quiz starts.

plate.title: GOLD MINE
plate.subtitle: The Claim Office
plate.design_notes: Use founder art 2 unaltered as the plate texture. Keep its energy: floating scroll upper-centre, cave arch framing it, gold nuggets and coins heaped low-left and low-right, stone shaft in the middle. Frame: plain riveted brass rectangle over dark mine-timber backing; procedural, no ornament. Lighting: warm lamp key from below-left matching the gold pile, cool blue fill from the cave top, a slow warm glint sweeping across the coin heaps every few seconds, faint dust motes. Stamp hierarchy: 1) the art's GOLD MINE title (no overlays on the scroll), 2) brass nameplate under the frame reading 'The Claim Office', 3) Recorder's ink stamp bottom-right that thumps on when the scorecard is issued, 4) small vest-clock icon top-right as the office mark. Coin emblems are in the founder art as-is; confirm with the founder that they are approved before shipping.
